Definition of a "Qualified Recruitment Lead" • Question: How does NMARNG define a “qualified recruitment lead,” and what minimum information, eligibility indicators, or prospect actions must be present before a lead is considered qualified for contractor performance purposes? • Answer: A 'qualified lead' is formally defined as an individual between the ages of 17 and 34 who is currently enrolled in high school or possesses a high school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) equivalent, and for whom the Contractor has successfully captured at least one valid, actionable method of contact (including, but not limited to, a telephone number, email address, or verified social media profile). Payment to the contractor shall be for the actual quantity shipped. 5. DELIVERY PROCEDURES • The hay shall be delivered within the contract’s twelve (12)‑month period of performance beginning on the date of award. • The alfalfa contractor shall coordinate all deliveries with the BLM’s delegated COR. • The facility contractor shall unload the hay bales with their on-site tractor. As a result, the alfalfa contractor shall coordinate all deliveries with the COR so they can be coordinated with the facility contractor three workdays prior to shipping the alfalfa. The alfalfa contractor shall furnish the COR the following: ➢ Anticipated shipment date. ➢ Total tonnage to be shipped /tonnage tickets; and ➢ Name of the carrier responsible for the shipment. Deliveries shall be made between the hours of 7:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m., local time, Monday through Friday, excluding weekends and federal holidays. Federal holidays are listed below • New Year’s Day • Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr. • Washington’s

Columbus Day • Veterans Day • Thanksgiving Day • Christmas Day If an emergency occurs, deliveries shall be requested/ordered by the COR for a Saturday, Sunday, or federal holiday. If an emergency occurs and alfalfa hay shall be ordered, the contractor shall have five calendar days after the order is placed, to have the ordered amount delivered. If a delivery happens to fall on a Saturday, Sunday, or federal holiday, the contractor shall coordinate with the COR to work for point of contact at delivery site. Deliveries shall be coordinated with the COR to arrive within a four-hour window. All deliveries shall be inspected by the on-site COR and shall be subject to their approval and acceptance or rejection (in the event of non-compliant hay). Any hay rejected shall be removed and replaced with acceptable hay according to the specifications outlined in this document at the contractor’s expense. Contractor shall remove rejected hay within 10 business days and replace with conforming hay within 10 business days after pickup. Replacement hay shall not count toward monthly order limits and shall not require issuance of a new delivery order. (End of provision) 52.212-2 Evaluation – Commercial Products and Commercial Services (a) Evaluation factors. The Government will award a firm-fixed price (FFP) contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following may be considered when evaluating offers: technical acceptability, price, and schedule. The review will result in the selection of the offer that represents the best value to the Government. Important Note: The final selection may not be the lowest priced offer. (b) Notice of award. A written notice of award or acceptance of an offer furnished to the successful Offeror within the time for acceptance specified in the offer, shall result in a binding contract without further action by either party. Before the offer’s specified expiration time, the Government may accept an offer (or part of an offer), whether or not there are negotiations after its receipt, unless a written notice of withdrawal is received before award. (End of provision) 4.
